notes.title: Alec Adventure Patch Notes - 11-03-2022
notes.notes:
[h1]PATCH NOTES:[/h1]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where a hidden achievement was unattainable. [i]A silly oversight on my part.[/i]
[*] Fixed bug where changing the SFX Volume did not change the Charge-Up Gun reload volume.
[*] Fixed bug where playing with a Controller would move around the Cursor as well. [i]Not very fun when using more than one monitor..[/i]
[/list]

[h2]TWEAKS/CHANGES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked The Big Green Meanie to be less frustrating to fight.[i] It's the first boss damnit..[/i]
[*] Edited a few falling platforms on World 2 to stay a little longer in the air.
[*] Some level design changes in World 3.
[*] Changed Neutral Route ending text to clarify that you [b]are[/b] allowed to kill enemies in Boss Rooms for the Pacifist Route. [i]I'm sorry Leo..[/i]
[/list]

[h2]PLANS/FUTURE CHANGES[/h2]

Unfortunately, not much. Other than the occasional bug squashing, I don't plan to change much about Alec Adventure since I believe it's in a finished state. Hopefully, I can manage to add more languages soon (currently only playable in English). After that's done, I can happily move on to work on more games. Thank you for being patient with me, until next time!

notes.title: Alec Adventure - Official Release Date!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Alec Adventure[/b] has been set on Steam with a [i]very[/i] ambitious 2021 release. [/h1]

Unfortunately, being a very busy guy with little to no experience in game development, it's been pushed back.. [i]a lot.[/i] But today I'm happy to announce it is coming out.. [b]TOMORROW![/b]

Everything is set,[i] (most)[/i] bugs have been squashed, and this little project of mine is finally being released to the public. I would like to give a very huge "thank you" to all of the close people that gave me so much support, [i]you all kept me mentally stable.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41195621/f7682803f931780c18ef144f1c307b2095f997a9.gif[/img]

And we can't forget about the the birthday boy himself; [b]Happy birthday Alec![/b] 

[h2]Good luck on your adventure![/h2]

[u][b]Official Release Date: October 27th, 12pm PST.[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41195621/acf323320f610d01c43cd2d6dc412f2074b7cd62.gif[/img]
